leads.name: Sample Lead Business A
leads.hook: Opened 8 months ago with 67 reviews and growing fast — strong engagement signals operational maturity and openness to new vendor partnerships that can support their growth phase.
leads.email: Hi — I came across your business while researching the Houston market and was impressed by your early traction (67 reviews in 8 months is strong). I think there's a real opportunity for us to work together. Would you be open to a quick 10-minute call this week?

sendStrategy.followUp: If no reply in 3 days, follow up with a specific value proposition tied to a pain point visible in their reviews

leads.name: Sample Lead Business B
leads.hook: Recent reviews mention service delays — a classic growth pains signal showing the business is scaling but lacks the infrastructure to keep up. Prime timing for a solution provider.
leads.email: Hey — I noticed a few recent reviews mentioning wait times at your location. When businesses grow this fast, operations often need to catch up. We help Houston businesses solve exactly this kind of scaling challenge. Happy to share a few quick ideas if useful.

sendStrategy.followUp: Send a brief case study email if no callback within 48 hours

leads.name: Sample Lead Business C
leads.hook: 142 reviews with strong engagement but owner responses stopped 3 months ago — suggests operational pressure or bandwidth constraints, making them receptive to solutions that reduce their workload.
leads.email: Hi — your business has outstanding reviews (142!) and clearly a loyal following. I noticed your review responses dropped off recently — often a sign of a team that's stretched thin. We work with Houston businesses to streamline operations. Would a 15-minute intro call be worth your time?

sendStrategy.followUp: Follow up via Instagram DM with a brief success story from a similar business

leads.name: Sample Lead Business D
leads.hook: Opened 11 months ago, 89 reviews — strong early traction with minimal online presence beyond Google. High growth trajectory suggests they'll need scalable support services soon.
leads.email: Hi — 89 reviews in under a year is impressive for a new business. You're clearly doing something right. I work with growing Houston businesses to help them scale without the usual growing pains. Would love to share one idea that might be a fit — takes 5 minutes to explain.

sendStrategy.followUp: Visit in person with a brief one-page proposal if phone call doesn't connect
